topics.title: 课程作业与考核规范
topics.summary: 丹麦科技大学对作业中使用生成式AI持开放支持态度，允许学生在学业中使用，但必须清晰说明使用方式并遵循规范引注。
topics.scope: 全校AI信息中心学习指引

claims.text: DTU permits AI use in studies provided students clearly indicate when and how tools were used and adhere to citation rules.

evidence.quote: The answer is yes, as long as students clearly indicate when and how they are utilizing AI. It’s essential to follow the rules for proper citation when using generative AI.
evidence.title: Rules and FAQ (DTU AI Info Hub)
evidence.location: Can students use AI in their studies?

topics.title: 考试与考场纪律
topics.summary: 丹麦技术大学指出，部分课程和考试目前允许使用AI；须核对具体课程及考试要求。
topics.scope: 选定开网考核试点课程

claims.text: DTU says AI is currently allowed in some courses and exams.

evidence.quote: AI is currently allowed in some courses and exams. In these courses, learning objectives are adjusted to accommodate AI usage, and the exam format assumes that students can master critical thinking skills.
evidence.title: Rules and FAQ (DTU AI Info Hub)
evidence.location: Can student use AI in their exams?

topics.title: AI使用声明与引注
topics.summary: 丹麦技术大学图书馆提供生成式AI引用指南，其中包括荣誉守则链接。
topics.scope: 图书馆引注标准与荣誉准则
topics.evidenceScope: DTU Library citation guide and honor code

claims.text: DTU Library provides a referencing guide for generative AI that includes links to the code of honour.

evidence.quote: The library has created a guide for referencing when using generative AI, which also includes links to DTU’s code of honour.
evidence.title: Rules and FAQ (DTU AI Info Hub)

topics.title: 隐私与数据保护
topics.summary: 内容涉及GDPR或对丹麦技术大学运营或个人至关重要时，指引建议考虑使用网页版Copilot。

claims.text: When content is subject to GDPR or critical to DTU operations or individuals, the guidance says to consider using Copilot for the web.

evidence.quote: If the content is subject to GDPR or is critical for DTU’s operations or individuals, consider using Copilot for the web. It’s a Microsoft AI solution built on ChatGPT 4.0.
evidence.title: Rules and FAQ (DTU AI Info Hub)
evidence.location: What’s important to know when choosing an AI tool?

topics.title: 认可与支持的AI工具
topics.summary: DTU实行基于信任的开放管理，未设立封闭的禁用工具黑名单，强调常识判断与明确引注。
topics.scope: 基于信任的开放工具生态

claims.text: DTU does not operate a closed restrictive tool whitelist, instead emphasizing common sense, honor code, and clear attribution.

evidence.quote: Currently, DTU does not have rules regarding which AI tools are allowed or prohibited. However, they emphasize common sense, awareness of DTU’s honor code, and clear source attribution.
evidence.title: Rules and FAQ (DTU AI Info Hub)
evidence.location: Which AI tools are allowed at DTU?

topics.title: 科研与论文署名
topics.summary: 科研诚信准则要求在基金项目申请书撰写中保持透明与负责；面向全部学术出版的AI署名规范属于未核实政策缺口。
topics.scope: 科研申报指引（通用论文署名规范未核实）

claims.text: Integrity guidelines emphasize transparency in research proposal preparation; comprehensive publication authorship rules remain an unverified policy gap.

evidence.quote: Acknowledge the limitations of the AI tool in the proposal preparation, including the potential for bias, errors, and gaps in knowledge.
evidence.title: Research integrity and AI-assisted research
evidence.location: Living guidelines on responsible use in research

additionalTopics.title: 教学实践原则
additionalTopics.summary: 鼓励教师重构课程设计，将生成式AI作为技术与教学法结合的工具直接融入教学材料与作业中。
additionalTopics.scope: 教师课程创新与AI融入指引
